mapper.select:
/* selectSrvySndngList (설문발송 대상자 선택 리스트 조회) - Lee Hye Sun */
SELECT X.INST_NO --기관번호 , X.INST_NM --기관명 , X.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM --서비스실행사업명 , X.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO --서비스실행사업번호 , X.TRPR_REL_CD --대상자관계구분코드 , X.TRPR_REL --대상자관계명 , X.RSPDNT --응답자 , X.RSPDNT_RCPTN --응답자수신번호 , CASE WHEN X.RSPDNT_BRDT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE X.RSPDNT_BRDT || '(만' || TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), TO_DATE(X.RSPDNT_BRDT, 'YYYYMMDD')) / 12) || '세)' END AS RSPDNT_BRDT --응답자생년월일 , X.TRPR_INFO_NO --대상자정보번호 , X.APLY_RCPT_SN --신청접수일련번호 , X.TRPR_NM_ENCPT --대상자 , CASE WHEN X.TRPR_BRTH_YMD IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE X.TRPR_BRTH_YMD || '(만' || TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), TO_DATE(X.TRPR_BRTH_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD')) / 12) || '세)' END AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD --대상자생년월일(만나이) , X.SXDC_SE_CD_NM --대상자성별 , X.SXDC_SE_CD --대상자성별코드 , X.ACBG_SE_CD --대상자학력 , X.BIZ_YR , X.CASE_MNG_NO , X.CASE_MNG_ODRNO FROM ( --대상자 SELECT D.INST_NO --기관번호 , D.INST_NM --기관명 , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM --서비스실행사업명 , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO --서비스실행사업번호 , CASE WHEN F.TRPR_REL_SE_CD = '11' THEN '11' ELSE '11' END AS TRPR_REL_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRPR_REL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '11' ) AS TRPR_REL --대상자관계명 , DEC_B64(F.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS RSPDNT --응답자 , DEC_B64(F.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS RSPDNT_RCPTN --응답자수신번호 , F.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS RSPDNT_BRDT --응답자생년월일 , F.TRPR_INFO_NO , W.APLY_RCPT_SN --신청접수일련번호 , DEC_B64(F.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM_ENCPT --대상자 , F.TRPR_BRTH_YMD --대상자생년월일(만나이) , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SXDC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = F.SXDC_SE_CD ) AS SXDC_SE_CD_NM --대상자성별 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SXDC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = F.SXDC_SE_CD ) AS SXDC_SE_CD --대상자성별코드 , C.ACBG AS ACBG_SE_CD --대상자학력 , S.BIZ_YR --사업연도 , E.CASE_MNG_NO , E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO FROM SEB120 A /*서비스사업대상자*/ LEFT JOIN SDA420 B /*서비스실행사업*/ ON A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SDA400 S /*서비스사업*/ ON B.SRVC_BIZ_NO = S.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 D /*통합기관*/ ON D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} LEFT JOIN SEB100 E /*사례기본*/ ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SEA200 F /*대상자정보*/ ON E.TRPR_INFO_NO = F.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN AFA100 W /*신청접수*/ ON F.TRPR_INFO_NO = W.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRPR_INFO_NO , ACBG FROM ( SELECT Q1.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Q1.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY Q2.SRTNG_SQNCE DESC, Q3.SRTNG_SQNCE DESC) ROW_NO , NVL(Q2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, ' ') || NVL(Q4.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, ' ') || NVL(Q3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, ' ') AS ACBG --대상자학력 FROM SEA230 Q1 LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q2 /* 최종학력구분코드 */ ON Q2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND Q2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = Q1.ACBG_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q3 /* 졸업상태 구분코드 */ ON Q3.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD' AND Q3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = Q1.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q4 /* 학년 구분코드 */ ON Q4.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' AND Q4.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = Q1.GRADE_SE_CD WHERE Q1.DEL_YN = 'N' ) WHERE ROW_NO = 1 ) C ON C.TRPR_INFO_NO = F.TRPR_INFO_NO
UNION --보호자 SELECT D.INST_NO --기관번호 , D.INST_NM --기관명 , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM --서비스실행사업명 , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO --서비스실행사업번호 , CASE WHEN F.TRPR_REL_SE_CD = '12' THEN '12' ELSE '12' END AS TRPR_REL_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRPR_REL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '12' ) AS TRPR_REL --대상자관계명 , DEC_B64(F.PRTCR_NM_ENCPT) AS RSPDNT --응답자 , DEC_B64(F.PRTCR_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS RSPDNT_RCPTN --응답자수신번호 , F.PRTCR_BRTH_YMD AS RSPDNT_BRDT --응답자생년월일 , F.TRPR_INFO_NO , W.APLY_RCPT_SN --신청접수일련번호 , DEC_B64(F.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM_ENCPT --대상자 , F.TRPR_BRTH_YMD --대상자생년월일(만나이) , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SXDC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = F.SXDC_SE_CD ) AS SXDC_SE_CD_NM --대상자성별 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SXDC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = F.SXDC_SE_CD ) AS SXDC_SE_CD --대상자성별코드 , C.ACBG AS ACBG_SE_CD --대상자학력 , S.BIZ_YR --사업연도 , E.CASE_MNG_NO , E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO FROM SEB120 A /*서비스사업대상자*/ LEFT JOIN SDA420 B /*서비스실행사업*/ ON A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SDA400 S /*서비스사업*/ ON B.SRVC_BIZ_NO = S.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 D /*통합기관*/ ON D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} LEFT JOIN SEB100 E /*사례기본*/ ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SEA200 F /*대상자정보*/ ON E.TRPR_INFO_NO = F.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN AFA100 W /*신청접수*/ ON F.TRPR_INFO_NO = W.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRPR_INFO_NO , ACBG FROM ( SELECT Q1.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Q1.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY Q2.SRTNG_SQNCE DESC, Q3.SRTNG_SQNCE DESC) ROW_NO , NVL(Q2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, ' ') || NVL(Q4.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, ' ') || NVL(Q3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, ' ') AS ACBG --대상자학력 FROM SEA230 Q1 LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q2 /* 최종학력구분코드 */ ON Q2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND Q2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = Q1.ACBG_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q3 /* 졸업상태 구분코드 */ ON Q3.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD' AND Q3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = Q1.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q4 /* 학년 구분코드 */ ON Q4.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' AND Q4.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = Q1.GRADE_SE_CD WHERE Q1.DEL_YN = 'N' ) WHERE ROW_NO = 1 ) C ON C.TRPR_INFO_NO = F.TRPR_INFO_NO ) X WHERE 1=1 AND X.BIZ_YR LIKE #{BIZ_YR} || '%' AND X.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND X.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LIKE #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} || '%' AND X.TRPR_REL_CD LIKE #{TRPR_REL_CD} || '%' AND X.RSPDNT LIKE '%' || #{RSPDNT} || '%' AND X.TRPR_NM_ENCPT LIKE '%' || #{TRPR_NM_ENCPT} || '%' AND X.RSPDNT_RCPTN LIKE #{RSPDNT_RCPTN} || '%'
ORDER BY X.TRPR_INFO_NO, X.TRPR_NM_ENCPT
